states: Private mock stack (8-node estate) built from this tree with a local-only generator overlay: pve2, pve3 and pve5 report the legacy sensors -j payload; pve2 has a Proxmox-inventory hdd disk with no temperature, pve3 a SATA disk whose reading is retained (host agent stopped reporting), pve5 a SATA disk with no temperature.

Overview, Storage, Replication and Backups each show the warning notice naming pve2, pve3 and pve5 at both viewports. The Overview query is type=agent,vm,system-container,oci-container and no physical_disk request is made on Overview, Replication or Backups; only Storage requests disk rows.

Before control on the same stack with origin/main's ProxmoxPageSurface.tsx and sensorSetup.ts swapped in: no notice on Overview, Replication or Backups, and Storage names only pve5 (hdd type and retained reading missed).

Websocket frames carry sensorSetupOutdated true on every tab. Fresh desktop load: no console errors and no 5xx responses. Notice text fits the 390px viewport without overflow; the node table stays below it in reading order.
Mock data only; not a real pre-rc.6 SSH node, installed upgrade or release acceptance.
interactions: Navigated each tab by URL at 1440x900 and 390x844 and waited 20s on Overview to outlast websocket row merges; the notice stayed.

Live clearing without reload: switching pve5's disk to a current 37C reading dropped pve5 from the notice (3 nodes to pve2, pve3) on the next websocket update. Control with the earlier omitempty backend kept pve5 for 90s.
